verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a scheduling SaaS with a public REST API and webhooks, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production environment. The docs instead point developers to try the API "on your own account" with a personal access token, which means working against live data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
